text: Groupe SOFT, the Stade Brestois 29 partner (Société d'Organisation Financière et Technique, Breton tertiary-building group), is now carried by the Brest holding VALEANSE (SIREN 798816682, SAS, 490 rue Augustin Jacq, Brest, created 2024-08-01, trading as Groupe SOFT), chaired by Fabrice Paul Lucien Boudinet — the group's founder-family name. No state or sovereign-fund stake was found in the chain.
short: Groupe SOFT is carried by the Brest holding Valeanse, chaired by Fabrice Boudinet.

source.name: Annuaire des entreprises (recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr), SIREN 798816682
source.note: Same response: nature juridique 5710 (SAS); the company's legal name line reads 'VALEANSE (GROUPE SOFT)'.
